lines.3: Good. Apparently even she was not going to hover over me all day.
lines.4: If she nagged me around the clock, I would go bald.
lines.5: I drank the green tea Otome had brewed.
lines.8: 「...I thought I measured it correctly. Forgive me. I have little confidence in delicate work.」
lines.9: 「I feel bad complaining when you made it for me.」
lines.10: 「I would much prefer that to silent complaints in your head.」
lines.11: 「By the way, this came around from the neighbors while I was tending the garden earlier.」
lines.13: 「It appears there have been two sneak-thief incidents nearby.」
lines.14: 「Huh. Crime like that is unusual here.」
lines.16: 「...If a thief enters this house, do not even think of fighting. Think only of your life and run.」
lines.17: 「Leave the thief to me. I will make sashimi of them.」
lines.19: 「What are you saying? Leaving it to you would be far more dangerous.」
lines.23: 「I wondered what you were going to say. How absurd.」
lines.24: 「A little brother should stay behind his big sister. I will protect you.」
lines.26: 「My pride as a man won't let me make a girl do that.」
lines.27: 「Pride is a noble thing built only through continual discipline of the self.」
lines.28: 「You are ten years too early to speak of it.」
lines.31: 「Good. This is an ideal opportunity to clarify the hierarchy in this house.」
lines.32: 「Challenge me. The winner stands above the loser.」
lines.36: 「So that you will obey my orders smoothly in an emergency.」
lines.38: 「Arm wrestling. That should favor a man.」
lines.39: 「Why would you deliberately choose something that puts you at a disadvantage?」
lines.40: 「Because you lack the proper regard for me as your big sister.」
lines.41: 「I must show you how strong your big sister is.」
lines.42: 「At present, you imagine the household hierarchy like this, do you not?」
